classifiedFinding.title: setDepletionDuration has no minimum-duration floor and no two-step gate; one-tx flash drain of rewardBalance

classification.assetImpact: Owner can collapse depletion window to 1 second; the next _updatePool credits the entire rewardBalance to accStablePerShare in a single block. Bundleable with a flash-stake to capture the full pool.
attackPath: 1. Adversarial owner observes a substantial rewardBalance.
2. In one MEV bundle: setDepletionDuration(1) → stake(huge_amount) → _updatePool absorbs entire rewardBalance into accStablePerShare → claim() pulls the full pool → withdraw stake.
3. All rewardToken funding by external funders is captured by the owner-aligned staker.
classification.likelihood: depends on owner trust; the function is onlyOwner
classification.externalRequirements: Owner key control; non-zero rewardBalance at the moment of attack

classifiedFinding.justification: onlyOwner setter with no gate at all (asymmetric vs setDesiredAPY which at least has a two-step). Real structural defect (missing MIN_DEPLETION_DURATION, missing gate). Trigger is admin action — per C4, this is Centralization. Strictly worse than DEDUP-006 because there is no friction at all. Strong remediation pointer for the C report: add minimum-duration floor + two-step gate symmetric with setDesiredAPY.
classifiedFinding.notes: Sanitizer hinted potential-high. Classifier disagrees: trigger is owner-only. Belongs in C bundle with the strongest commentary of any C finding given the no-gate asymmetry. If the C bundle ranks findings by severity, this should be the top item.
